He sat in the pilot's seat of the Starjammer and gazed out at the abyss - blacker than black yet *something* was out there, something born of the void. "Syra, run preliminary checks." "All systems nominal, reactor output at 6%." "Scrub warp drive." "Scrubbed." "Flood hyperdrive and fire the ramjet, two seconds. Standard prep procedure." He could see the crack in the sky now. Tachyon sensors were picking up a mass larger than any celestial body he had seen - *No matter, nuclear fire cleanses all. There will be nothing but ashes here when I return, if ever I return at all.* "Disperse probes 1-24." A rapid retort of *phoonk*s sounded, each one sounding that a standard observation probe had launched. These probes carried a nav system on it, as well as a standard observation suite and entangled transmitter - and a special packet of "grey goo" as a warhead. Once their scanning was done, they would one by one streak inwards and eat away at the ships. He had no idea how much damage they would cause, but he did know that they would at least distract them. "Hyperdrive to 10%. Prepare to jump. Three… two… one… fire."
